selected_skill.purpose: Use the bundled OOXML workflow and Word-document handling guidance to complete a branded .docx packet without rebuilding the deliverable in another format.

skillsmp_references.name: docx.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: Direct match for creating and editing .docx deliverables with image replacement, find/replace, and review-state cleanup.

skillsmp_references.name: ocr-and-documents.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent document-processing workflow with structured extraction and document handling overlap.

skillsmp_references.name: nano-pdf.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent documents workflow for layout-aware inspection, useful as a comparison point but not the chosen path.

skillsmp_references.name: editor.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: General document refinement skill, relevant to delivery polish but less specific than docx OOXML editing.

environment_design.determinism: The task ships fixed public-data snapshots, a fixed draft .docx, and a fixed delivery contract. Verifier-side checks recompute expected metrics from the local snapshots and inspect the generated .docx package rather than trusting filenames or summaries alone.
anti_toy_features: an existing branded Word draft with header/footer, appendix entry, placeholder tables, placeholder images, and review residue
public-source datasets with different formats and update cadences, requiring per-metric common-year handling
required chart replacement inside the final .docx package rather than a sidecar image export
a formal local build entrypoint that must remain reusable on alternate fixtures
manifest cross-checks against document sections, table ids, chart ids, and metric vintages
document-package checks that catch placeholder carry-over, comment residue, and style-shell replacement

main_tests: formal build entrypoint produces the required .docx and manifest
document text includes the required sections, headings, and data-derived metrics
header, footer, and style shell from the draft are preserved
placeholder image slots are replaced and comment residue is cleared
manifest and document package stay consistent on sections, chart ids, and metric years
alternate-fixture reruns change the chart media and the computed metrics
guardrails: the shipped briefing input area remains unchanged
top-level output inventory exactly matches the contract
no placeholder-oriented or verifier-oriented strings remain in the formal outputs

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: Without the bundled docx workflow, agents often drift into rebuilding the packet in another format, leave review residue in OOXML, or skip in-place media replacement because the path from draft package to final package is less obvious.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The skill gives the agent a concrete route for unpacking, editing, validating, and repacking the .docx package, which materially improves the odds of preserving the branded shell while replacing the document internals correctly.
